description: This PHP class, Averages, provides implementations of various statistical functions such as AVERAGE, MEDIAN, MODE, AVEDEV, and AVERAGEA for the PhpSpreadsheet library. These functions are used within the library to perform calculations on data ranges often in spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: Averages
classes.description: Provides implementations for various statistical average functions for the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: averageDeviations
methods.description: Calculates the average of absolute deviations from the mean (AVEDEV).

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the arithmetic mean (average) of given data values.

methods.name: averageA
methods.description: Calculates the average including numbers, text, and logical values (AVERAGEA).

methods.name: median
methods.description: Calculates the median value of the data set.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Finds the most frequently occurring value in the data set.
